assets. And because fintech connects to almost everything, our
work naturally extends to fields like sustainability, health and
mobility.

Frequently Asked Questions
About Startup
Funding and
Programs

Tenity’s startup funding and programs are designed for founders at
every stage – from the earliest idea through to Series A. Our
programs combine structured acceleration with direct access to
corporate partners, investors, and mentors across six global hubs in
Zurich, Singapore, London, Madrid, Istanbul, and Hong Kong. Whether
you are looking for pre-seed investment, a pilot with a financial
institution, or a structured program to validate your product, Tenity
provides the support, network, and capital to help you scale with
confidence. With 200+ portfolio companies, 250 PoCs delivered, and
100+ programs run, our track record speaks for itself.

What kind of startups does Tenity work with?

Tenity works with early-stage startups and scaleups across fintech, AI, digital assets, and adjacent innovation fields. Our startup funding and programs are open to founders at ideation, pre-revenue, and MVP stage — across multiple sectors and geographies.

Does Tenity invest in startups?

Yes. Tenity invests in selected startups through its venture capital platform, from pre-seed to Series A. Investment is available independently.

Are Tenity startup programs equity-free?

Some of Tenity’s startup funding and programs are equity-free, while others involve investment or longer-term partnerships. Terms vary by program — check the individual program page for details.

How can startups collaborate with corporates through Tenity?

Through Tenity’s startup funding and programs, founders get direct access to 65+ corporate partners including global financial institutions, insurers, and technology companies — enabling pilots, PoCs, and commercial partnerships that create real business outcomes.

How do startups get started with Tenity?

Explore available startup funding and programs on the Tenity website and apply directly to the program that matches your stage, focus, and goals.

What makes Tenity’s startup funding and programs different from a typical accelerator?

Unlike standalone accelerators, Tenity’s startup funding and programs combine venture capital investment with corporate access and ecosystem connectivity. Founders don’t just get mentorship and a demo day — they get direct introductions to financial institutions, insurers, and technology companies that can become their first enterprise clients or co-investors. This combination of capital, structure, and commercial access is what sets Tenity apart.

Which geographies do Tenity’s startup funding and programs cover?

Tenity’s startup funding and programs operate across six global hubs — Zurich, Singapore, London, Madrid, Istanbul, and Hong Kong — giving founders access to two of the world’s most active innovation corridors: Europe and Asia. Programs are open to international applicants regardless of where you are based, and many founders relocate temporarily to a hub city during the program.
